whatIs.title: What is CS Learning Hub?
whatIs.description: A unified learning platform that brings together 5 CS tools: Quiz, Dictionary, Interview Prep, Algorithm Visualizer, and CS Concept Visualizer. Track your progress and study systematically following the recommended learning path.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Follow the learning roadmap starting from the Dictionary
Track your progress on the dashboard
Identify weak areas and focus your study

tips.title: Study Tips
items: Study 30 minutes daily to complete the entire curriculum in a month
Study multiple categories evenly rather than going deep in just one
Use visualization tools to intuitively understand abstract concepts
Preparing for follow-up questions significantly improves interview success

items.a: Non-CS majors: Dictionary → Visualizer → Quiz. CS majors: Take a quiz to find weak areas, then focus study there.

items.q: Do I need to use all tools?
items.a: Choose based on your goal. For urgent interview prep, focus on Interview. For building foundations, prioritize Dictionary + Visualizer + Quiz.
All learning records are stored in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent to any server.
